description: This source file is a command-line tool for processing root certificate store data, including reading, decoding, and generating C++ header files for trust anchors and EV root metadata, primarily used in the Chromium project.

methods.name: DecodeCerts
methods.description: Decodes PEM-encoded certificates into a map from SHA-256 hex hash to DER certificate data.

methods.name: ReadTextRootStore
methods.description: Reads and parses a root store protobuf from a text file, optionally decoding associated certificates.

methods.name: WriteRootCppFile
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file with trust anchor certificates embedded as byte arrays.

methods.name: WriteEvCppFile
methods.description: Generates a C++ header file with EV root CA metadata.
